title: Hanasato Minori — Pre-Show Prep〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Tomorrow's the day!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The day we perform on stage to cheer Haruka up with that beautiful sea of blue!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It's an important day, so I should sleep early.
Okay, let me turn off the lights now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Urgh! I'm wide awake because I'm feeling so nervous... I won't be able to fall asleep like this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Unlike Momoi and Hinomori, I've never performed on a stage before.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What if I make a mistake and end up disappointing Haruka instead?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-Stop thinking like this!
You promised Momoi and Hinomori you'd try your very best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can't waver at this crucial moment...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? My smartphone just...
Isn't that the light from—

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Good evening, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Miku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Are you looking for me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. I thought you seemed a little nervous at today's rehearsal.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I was worried about that, so I decided to drop by. Sorry for disturbing you at this late hour.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's no problem at all! I'm really happy to see you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you for coming, Miku.
You're right. I'm so worried that I haven't been able to fall asleep.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Even though Momoi and Hinomori are supporting the plan, and you and Rin are helping out, too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I feel bad about becoming so nervous just before the show...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, Minori...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It's normal for people to feel nervous before trying out something new. In fact, the more you practice, the more you become afraid of making a mistake.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But don't forget that you're not alone, Minori.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Airi and Shizuku will be performing with you tomorrow. And don't forget that Rin and I will be there, too.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Everyone will be there to support you!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yup. You have friends around you who are ready to put in their best effort together with you.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So you'll be fine! If it ever seems like you're about to make a mistake, we'll be right there to back you up!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Have confidence when you're on the stage, Minori! Let's bring the brightest hope to Haruka together!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hope to Haruka...together...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes...you're right.
On the stage, I'm not alone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was so nervous I completely forgot about that important fact. Thank you for reminding me, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe, you're smiling like your usual self again.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'm glad you're feeling more relaxed now.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll work hard tomorrow like I always do, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I just need to remember my practice sessions with Momoi and Hinomori and everything will be just fine!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll make sure Haruka receives all the hope that she's given me so far!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, let's put all our strength into tomorrow's show!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Go, go, go!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Go!>
